Privacy Policy
Math Grader AI LLC ("Company," "we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting the privacy of teachers, students, and
educational institutions. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard personal information in
compliance with FERPA, SOPIPA, CCPA/CPRA, and other applicable laws.
1. Information We Collect
We collect only the information necessary to provide our grading services:
Teacher/School Information: Name, email address, account credentials.
Student Information: Uploaded exams, student names (if visible), AI-generated scores and feedback.
Usage Data: Teacher exam upload dates, usage statistics.
Payment Information: Processed securely via Stripe (no card data stored by us).
Cookies: For authentication and essential analytics.
We do not knowingly collect information directly from students or minors. Student data is uploaded only by authorized
teachers or schools.
2. How We Use Information
We use collected information solely to:
Deliver, support, and improve grading services.
Authenticate user accounts and manage access.
Generate scores and feedback from uploaded exams.
Fulfill transactions and maintain billing (via Stripe).
Improve platform reliability through aggregated, anonymized analytics.
We do not use student data for targeted advertising, profiling, or marketing.
3. Data Protection & Security
We maintain industry-standard and education-specific security practices:
Encryption: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256).
Access Controls: Row-Level Security ensures teachers/schools can only access their own data. Role-based permissions
restrict system access.
Audit Logs: Maintained at the application and infrastructure level (Supabase + Google Cloud).
Cloud Infrastructure: Supabase (database/storage) and Vercel (app hosting) with private buckets.
4. Student Data & Educational Records
We treat uploaded student exams as educational records under FERPA.
We act as a "school official" with a legitimate educational interest, processing data solely on behalf of schools and
districts.
AI Processing: Student exam data may be processed using third-party AI and cloud service providers acting solely on
our behalf. These providers are contractually prohibited from retaining, training on, or using student data for advertising,
profiling, or any purpose other than delivering the requested educational services.

Rubric Generation: Rubrics may be automatically generated to support grading using third-party AI services acting on
our behalf. This processing is performed solely for educational purposes and is subject to the same student data
protections described in this policy.
5. Data Retention & Deletion
Default retention: Student exam data is stored up to 6 months after the last teacher activity.
Custom retention: Schools/districts may set shorter timelines by contract.
Deletion:
Teachers/districts may request deletion at any time.
Accounts inactive for 6 months are scheduled for deletion, with 30-day notice.
We do not maintain backup storage. Deleted data is permanently and immediately removed from our systems.
6. Third-Party Services
We use vetted third-party service providers ("subprocessors") to operate and support the platform, including for
database hosting, authentication, payments, web hosting, and AI-powered features.
All subprocessors act solely on our behalf and are contractually bound to maintain strong privacy, confidentiality, and
security practices consistent with this policy and applicable education privacy laws.
7. Breach Notification
If a breach involving personal or student data occurs, we will notify affected schools and/or teachers promptly, and no
later than 72 hours after discovery, in accordance with FERPA and applicable state laws.
8. Privacy Rights
Teachers may request access, correction, or deletion of their data.
Schools/districts may request export or deletion of all student data.
Parents, through their school, may request access to or deletion of student records (FERPA).
Requests can be made at support@mathgrader.ai.
9. Policy Updates
We may update this policy as laws or practices change. If material changes are made, we will notify schools and
teachers by email and/or platform notice.
10. Contact Us
For questions or privacy-related requests:
support@mathgrader.ai
Math Grader AI LLC

Math Grader AI – Terms of Service
These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of Math Grader AI LLC ("Company," "we," "our," or "us") and the
Math Grader AI platform (the "Services"). By using our Services, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, you may
not use our Services.
1. Eligibility & Account Registration
You must be 18 years or older to create an account.
Accounts are created via Google Sign-In and require a valid email address.
If you are using the Services on behalf of a school or district, you represent that you are authorized to enter into this
agreement on their behalf.
2. Student Data & Educational Records
If you upload or submit student information, including names, tests, or scores ("Student Data"), you represent that:
You have the legal right and/or required permissions to share such data.
Such data is considered educational records under the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act ("FERPA") and
similar state laws.
We act as a school official with a legitimate educational interest, processing Student Data solely for the purpose of
providing our Services.
All Student Data remains the property of the school, district, or teacher who provided it.
In cases where a school or district has entered into an agreement with us, that entity shall be considered the primary
data controller, and teachers use the Services under the direction of their institution.
3. Privacy & Compliance
We comply with:
FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)
SOPIPA (Student Online Personal Information Protection Act)
California Education Code §49073.1
Applicable state student data privacy laws
We will:
Not sell or use Student Data for targeted advertising or marketing.
Process Student Data only as directed by the school, district, or teacher.
Delete Student Data upon request or as described in our Privacy Policy.
Our full Privacy Policy is available at: https://www.mathgrader.ai/legal/privacy
4. License to Use Services
We grant you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to access and use our Services solely for educational
purposes and in accordance with these Terms.
5. Payment & Refunds
Paid subscriptions are billed through Stripe.

Refunds are only provided as required by law.
Pricing and plans are described on our website and may change with notice.
6. Restrictions
You agree not to:
Upload Student Data without proper authorization.
Share account credentials or allow unauthorized access.
Reverse-engineer, copy, or modify the Services.
Use the Services for unlawful purposes or in violation of privacy laws.
You are solely responsible for the content and Student Data you upload to the Services.
7. Data Security
We use encryption in transit and at rest, access controls, and other industry-standard safeguards to protect Student
Data and personal information.
If a data breach occurs, we will notify affected parties in accordance with our Breach Response Plan and applicable
laws. Our Breach Response Plan is available upon request by schools or districts.
8. Data Retention & Deletion
Student Data is retained for up to 6 months after the last account activity, unless otherwise directed by the school,
district, or teacher.
Upon termination or written request, we will delete Student Data in accordance with our Privacy Policy, unless retention
is required by law.
9. Service Availability
We strive to maintain continuous availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. We may suspend or terminate
Services for maintenance, security, or other lawful reasons.
We may add, modify, or discontinue features, provided that such changes do not materially reduce the core functionality
of the Services without reasonable notice.
We do not guarantee specific grading outcomes, scores, or results from use of the Services.
10. Liability Limitations
To the fullest extent permitted by law:
We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.
For claims involving Student Data, our total liability will not exceed the amount you paid in the preceding 12 months,
except as otherwise required by law.
To the fullest extent permitted by law, Math Grader AI shall not be liable for any loss, corruption, or unavailability of data,
except to the extent caused by our gross negligence or willful misconduct.
11. Indemnification
You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Math Grader AI LLC, its officers, directors, employees, and agents
from and against any claims, damages, losses, liabilities, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising
out of or related to:
(a) your unauthorized upload, submission, or use of Student Data;
(b) your violation of these Terms or applicable law; or
(c) your misuse of the Services.

This indemnification obligation does not apply to the extent a claim arises from Math Grader AI's gross negligence or
willful misconduct.
12. Termination
We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these Terms. Upon termination, your license to use the
Services ends, and Student Data will be deleted according to Section 8.
13. Dispute Resolution
Unless otherwise specified in a district agreement, disputes will be resolved through binding arbitration rather than in
court, except that you may bring eligible claims in small claims court.
14. Accessibility & Nondiscrimination
We are committed to providing Services in compliance with applicable accessibility and nondiscrimination laws, including
Section 508 and the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).
15. Changes to These Terms
We may update these Terms periodically. Material changes will be communicated via email or platform notice.
Continued use of the Services after changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.
16. Contact
For questions about these Terms, email: support@mathgrader.ai
